objective: Measure whether unresolved-only micro3 refinement materially reduces certified-unknown volume and reveals zero-existence on a holdout not used for the exploratory post-X6C diagnostics.

exploratory_seed_exclusion.reason: Post-run local red-team already inspected a small set of micro3 roots; those root IDs are excluded from the confirmatory holdout.

holdout_construction.source: X6C FULL_DOMAIN_ROOT_STATES plus frozen field center SDF evaluations

cohorts.name: UNRESOLVED_COUNT_STRATIFIED
cohorts.rule: 8 deterministic evenly-spaced eligible UNKNOWN roots from each micro2 unresolved-count band [1,4], [5,16], [17,40], [41,64], after excluding exploratory IDs

cohorts.name: NEAR_ZERO_CENTER
cohorts.rule: 16 eligible UNKNOWN roots with smallest absolute direct center SDF, excluding exploratory IDs

cohorts.name: NEGATIVE_CENTER
cohorts.rule: 8 eligible UNKNOWN roots with most negative direct center SDF, excluding exploratory IDs

cohorts.name: POSITIVE_CENTER
cohorts.rule: 8 eligible UNKNOWN roots with most positive direct center SDF, excluding exploratory IDs

primary_metrics: micro2 unresolved volume units versus micro3 unresolved volume units
actual evaluated box count and wall time
claim_boundary: Holdout productivity only. No full-domain micro3 authorization is implied by preregistration.
